subject: english
prompt: A poem is difficult to chant because each line has very different timing. What is the best revision?

options.text: Adjust the wording so the lines have a more regular beat
Add unrelated facts to every line
Remove all verbs from the poem
Change every word into a proper name

answer.explanation: More regular timing makes a chant easier to perform and helps the audience follow its rhythm.
